_note: Street, ownership, events, industry, critiques, gaps and conflicts as of 30-Sep-2026. Notes and data published after 30-Sep-2026 are excluded (see updates/later-facts.json).

street._method: Every broker that discloses a method values Shriram Finance on price to book: Motilal Oswal 2.2x FY28E BVPS, ICICI Direct ~2.1x FY28E book, Emkay 2.1x FY28E book (implied by its Jun-27 target), Prabhudas Lilladher 2.4x Mar-28 adjusted book. All are Buy; targets ₹1,200-1,250.

brokers.thesis: Recent fall (~11% in a month) is macro-driven (West Asia, crude, bond yields, weak monsoon); AUM CAGR ~18% and PAT CAGR ~29% FY26-28E; NIM 9.2% / 9.1% FY27E/FY28E; ROA ~4%, ROE 13.5% by FY28; capital supports growth for 4-5 years
AUM +17% / +18% FY27E/28E; NIM (calc.) 9.9% / 9.7%; credit cost 2.0% / 1.9%; EPS ₹58.2 / ₹62.3; opex to stay elevated near 30% of income
Funding tailwinds and liquidity deployment support profitability; PAT ₹14,071 cr / ₹16,223 cr FY27E/28E; ABV ₹465 / ₹519; ROE 12.0% / 12.3%

events.title: Shriram City Union Finance and Shriram Capital merge into STFC; renamed Shriram Finance
events.detail: Appointed date 1-Apr-2022; FY23 numbers onward include the merged businesses (MSME, gold, personal loans, two-wheelers) and are not comparable with earlier years.

events.title: Sale of Shriram Housing Finance to Warburg Pincus completed
events.detail: 84.44% stake for ₹3,929 cr; standalone exceptional gain ₹1,656.77 cr pre-tax (₹1,489 cr after tax) in Q3FY25. FY25 reported EPS ₹51.92 vs ₹44.00 before the gain.

events.title: 1:5 share split (face value ₹10 to ₹2)
events.detail: Record date 10-Jan-2025; all per-share data in this report are split-adjusted.

events.title: MUFG Bank to buy 20% through a ₹39,618 cr preferential issue
events.detail: 47.11 cr new shares at ₹840.93 (USD ~4.4 bn), primary capital; shareholders approved on 14-Jan-2026; two MUFG nominees on the board; 24-month standstill on market purchases.
events.src: Q1FY27 results note 6; FY26 annual report p22, p73

events.title: MUFG shares allotted; AAA ratings follow
events.detail: ICRA and CRISIL upgraded to AAA/Stable on 9-Apr, India Ratings on 10-Apr, Fitch to BBB-/Stable on 14-Apr-2026. Borrowings fell from ₹2,50,690 cr (Mar-26) to ₹2,32,639 cr (Jun-26); leverage 3.82x to 2.14x.
events.src: Q4FY26 investor update p2; Q1FY27 call p4

events.title: Q4FY26 results: FY26 PAT ₹9,998 cr (+21% before the FY25 gain); FY27 budget 18% AUM growth
events.detail: Dividend ₹10.80 for FY26; management to revisit the budget after Q1 because of the West Asia war and fuel prices.

events.title: Q1FY27: PAT +60% to ₹3,445 cr, NIM 9.04%
events.detail: AUM +15.3%; ~₹500 cr of NII from the MUFG capital; ROE 12.8% on the enlarged equity; 18% guidance held, to be reassessed after Q2.

events.title: Stock down ~11% in a month
events.detail: West Asia escalation, crude rebound, higher bond yields and a weak monsoon (rainfall ~12% below normal year to date); Motilal Oswal reiterated Buy (₹1,220) on 29-Sep.

industry.autoSalesQ1FY27: CV sales +14.1% to 2.65 lakh units (M&HCV +18.3%, LCV +20.8%); PV +25.9% to 12.74 lakh; 2W +20.3%; 3W +29.7%; tractors +21.6%; construction equipment +8.8% after four quarters of decline; helped by GST rate cuts
industry.macro: RBI repo 5.25%, neutral stance; FY27 GDP forecast cut to 6.6%; CPI 4.38% in June 2026 (RBI forecast 5.1%); WPI 9.87%; IMD monsoon forecast cut to 90% of normal (El Nino), rainfall 24% below normal 4-Jun to 16-Jul

critiques: Valuation: ~1.8x forward book is the top of the stock's own 2021-26 range while ROE falls to ~13%
ROE diluted by the MUFG capital; leverage takes 5-6 years to rebuild
NIM guidance of 8.5% looks conservative against 9%+ today
Autonomous (on the Q1 call), Emkay, Motilal Oswal
Monsoon, El Nino, crude and West Asia hit rural and transporter cash flows
Opex stays elevated as branches and staff are added
Stage 3 stuck at ~4.6%, high for a large NBFC (Bajaj Finance 0.96%); construction equipment 7.1%, MSME 5.2%
gaps: No consensus EPS, book value or target dated on or before 30-Sep-2026; street figures are taken from individual notes or implied from their multiples.
Valuation methods for ICICI Securities (institutional), Axis Direct and IDBI Capital not disclosed in the sources we saw.
STFC provisions for FY18-FY20 not captured (credit-cost history starts FY21); FY19-FY20 gross / net Stage 3 not used because the order of values in the FY22 chart is ambiguous.
Shriram Housing Finance AUM at Mar-23 and Mar-24 not captured, so FY23-FY24 consolidated ratios on standalone AUM are slightly overstated (SHFL FY24 turnover ₹1,430 cr, total assets ₹11,859 cr).
New vs used split of the commercial-vehicle book not disclosed (management offered it offline on 24-Jul-2026); product yields and incremental yields not disclosed.
Exact denominator of the company's 'credit cost to total assets' and 'NIM' (monthly average total assets?) not disclosed; our ratios use average AUM.
Ownership and beneficiaries of Shriram Ownership Trust and Shriram Capital Pvt Ltd (the group holding chain) not verified from a primary source.
MUFG's intentions after the 24-month standstill (any plan to raise its stake) not disclosed; management declined to comment (Q4FY26 call).
Screener's trailing P/B for SHRIRAMFIN in Apr-Sep 2026 uses book per share that ignores the April MUFG issue (shows ~2.8-3.2x); we use price ÷ Jun-26 book (₹461.78) = 2.1x.
Beta of 1.15 is a house judgement, not a measured figure.
Disbursement and AUM data for Q1FY25 not captured; FY24 and earlier product mix not captured.
conflicts: ICICI Securities target: Trendlyne lists ₹1,225 (institutional, 25-Jul-2026); a DSIJ summary shows ₹1,200 at ~2.1x FY28E book, which matches the ICICI Direct retail note of 27-Jul. Listed separately.
Prabhudas Lilladher FY28E adjusted book: ₹518 in its estimate-change table, ₹517.6 in its financials; its BVPS FY27E ₹555 vs FY28E ₹562 looks internally inconsistent. We use ₹1,250 ÷ 2.4 = ₹521.
Screener's FY25 consolidated P&L (revenue ₹43,941 cr) differs from the audited continuing-operations P&L (₹41,834 cr); we patch it (tools/authoring/SHRIRAMFIN.patch.js).
Shriram Housing Finance sale value: ₹4,630 cr announced (incl. contingent amounts, Reuters May-2024) vs ₹3,929 cr at completion (company); we use ₹3,929 cr.
52-week high: ₹1,108 in the July broker notes vs a ₹1,130 weekly close on 21-Aug-2026 (Screener).
FY18 Stage 3 (9.4% gross, 6.4% net) read from the STFC FY22 annual report chart; the chart's value order is partly ambiguous.
